title: Track poker-stakes in git so the file-length cap can reach it
objective: poker-stakes/ exists on disk with 58 untracked files, four of which exceed the 250-line cap. An untracked directory is invisible to every pre-commit hook, so its violations cannot be fixed or gated until it is committed. Track it with its CI workflow and its existing evidence artifact.
acceptance_criteria: All 58 poker-stakes source and config files are tracked by git.
.github/workflows/poker-stakes-ci.yml is tracked so CI runs on the directory.
docs/superpowers/evidence/poker-stakes-ui-wiring-2026-08-14.json is tracked alongside the code it documents.
npm run check passes in poker-stakes/: typecheck, eslint --max-warnings 0, and vitest coverage at the configured 100% thresholds.
No binaries, no node_modules and no build output are staged.
The repo's pre-commit hooks all pass on the staged set.
out_of_scope: Splitting poker-stakes' four over-250-line files; that lands as a separate commit once the directory is tracked.
Any change to poker-stakes application behaviour, dependencies or CI definition.
The remaining file-length violations elsewhere in the repo.
verifier: cd poker-stakes && npm run check (exit 0, 220 tests, 100% statements/branches/functions/lines); git status --porcelain -uall poker-stakes returns empty afterwards; git ls-files poker-stakes | wc -l reports 58.
